metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.6 · 1979 · The Muppet Movie
metas.description: Kermit and his newfound friends trek across America to find success in Hollywood, but a frog legs merchant is after Kermit.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.1 · 1981 · The Great Muppet Caper
metas.description: Kermit the Frog, The Great Gonzo, and Fozzie Bear are reporters who travel to Britain to interview a rich victim of jewel thieves and help her along with her secretary, Miss Piggy.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.9 · 1984 · The Muppets Take Manhattan
metas.description: Kermit and his friends go to New York City to get their musical on Broadway only to find it's a more difficult task than they anticipated.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.8 · 1992 · The Muppet Christmas Carol
metas.description: The Muppets put their spin on the tale of an elder, Christmas-hating miser who is visited by spirits who foretell his future and share secrets from his past and present, which helps change his view on life.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 7.0 · 1996 · Muppet Treasure Island
metas.description: The Muppets set sail in search of treasure, with Jim Hawkins and Long John Silver.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.3 · 1999 · Muppets from Space
metas.description: Gonzo is contacted by his alien family through his breakfast cereal. But when the men in black kidnap him, it's up to Kermit and the gang to rescue Gonzo and help him reunite with his long-lost family.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 7.1 · 2011 · The Muppets
metas.description: A Muppet fanatic with some help from his 2 human compatriots must regroup the Muppet gang to stop an avaricious oil mogul from taking down one of their precious life-longing treasures.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.4 · 2014 · Muppets Most Wanted
metas.description: While on a grand world tour, The Muppets find themselves wrapped into an European jewel-heist caper headed by a Kermit the Frog look-alike and his dastardly sidekick.
